messages.author: d1acffd991fa4452
messages.subject: HuEx cdf based on current annotation
parts:
Hi all,

I was wondering if any cdf-file is available for the Human Exon Array
that includes Affymetrix transcript IDs and is mapped to one of the
recent released versions of the human genome (hg19). Currently I am
using the latest cdf from this page, though it seems pretty outdated:
http://www.aroma-project.org/node/122

Best regards

messages.subject: Re: HuEx cdf based on current annotation
parts:
Hi Steve,

Does this mean the CDF you're working on is not based on the NetAffx
annotation files?
I was planning to use the most recent of these CSV files provided by
Affy to annotate the transcript_IDs with their corresponding genes /
transcripts.
Since I am not sure how much the summarization/merge of probesets into
Affy transcripts differs between the CSV versions, it would be fatal
if FIRMA is run on a transcript model from 2007 while my annotation is
based on one from 2011.
So if any information regarding this matter, it would prove very
helpful.

Best regards

messages.author: d1acffd991fa4452
messages.subject: Re: HuEx cdf based on current annotation
parts:
Hey everyone,
Nevermind the last post, I figured I can easily check whether the Affy
transcript IDs have been altered between two major releases of
Affymetrix and it turns out they are still the same as in 2007 (at
least for the 1381294 probesets in the full data set, I did not check
the rest), so it is possible to use the recent CSV files (mapped to
hg19) to annotate them. Good to know, now moving on... ;)

Cheers
